energy-profile.alt: Potential energy on the vertical axis, reaction progress on the horizontal axis. The curve starts at the reactant level, rises to a peak labelled transition state, and falls to a product level lower than the reactants. A double arrow from the reactant level to the peak is the activation energy. A double arrow from the reactant level down to the product level is the energy change of the reaction; here energy is released because the products are lower.
